body:
Web half of T-364 (the design of record; read it in full first — the orchestrator hands you a
copy). Sections 2 (wire), 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 are the contract. The server half is being built in
parallel by another agent against the same design: code to the design, mock the server in
tests as the existing pages do, and do not wait for it.

## Deliverables

* `api/contract.ts`: `ListGuest {id, name, initials, locked, claimed_by, created_at}`,
  `guests?: ListGuest[]` on `ListObject`, `guest_names?: string[]` on a pushed list row.
  `api/client.ts`: the five guest calls. `api/protocol.ts`: `PROTOCOL_VERSION` 4 (floor
  unchanged). Guest controls, the create-dialog section and the chooser are gated on the
  server's protocol ≥ 4 the way other gated features are; reading `guests` is not.
* `lib/expenses.ts`: `aliasesOf(guests)`, `fold(expense, aliases)` (sum in cents, copy type /
  date / equal flags), used **before** `balancesFor`, `entryEffectCents`, `settle`,
  `spentTotals` and `formerMemberNumbers` everywhere; `participantLabel`-style resolution per
  the table in section 8; the frozen set and reason on stored keys per section 6.
  `lib/expenses.test.ts`: run the new `fold` group of `shared-test-cases/expense-arithmetic.json`
  (folded entries compared as wire maps, balances in order, total, settle), and property tests:
  sum-to-zero over folded entries for any alias map; empty aliases is identity; fold is
  idempotent.
* `ListPropsPage`: the Guests section under Members, ledgers only, exactly as section 8 (rows
  with outline badge, Rename inline, "Amounts locked" switch with its help line, "This is me",
  Remove disabled with the in-use reason while a live entry names the guest, "claimed by DP" /
  Unclaim, the Add guest field; read-only when closed; disabled with the voted hint while the
  viewer has voted).
* `OverviewPage` create dialog: the Guests section for the Ledger kind (dynamic name boxes,
  Add another, remove, hidden at 50, blanks dropped, `guest_names` on the creation row).
* `ExpenseDialog`: members and unclaimed guests as participants in roster order, guests marked;
  locked guests treated as voters are (fixed share, unselectable on a new entry; the T-196
  seeding must not zero a locked guest's share). Transfers may name guests.
* `ExpenseListPage` rows and `BalancesPage`: labels per the table; effect for the viewer's
  effective id; one balance row per effective id, guests marked, "amounts locked" line (its own
  string, not T-203's); Reimburse records with the guest's own id and is disabled for a locked
  guest. The post-join chooser: `RedeemPage` and the overview inbox navigate with a `joined`
  query flag; `ExpenseListPage` consumes it once and opens "Are you one of these?" with a button
  per unclaimed guest and "No, I'm new" when the list is a ledger with unclaimed guests.
* `i18n/apiErrors.ts`: `guest_not_found`, `guest_claimed`, `guest_in_use`,
  `invalid_guest_name`; `participant_frozen` wording names the participant via the label.
* Every new string in all ten message files (`en, de, fr, es, pt-BR, uk, ar, ja, zh-Hans,
  qaa`). The Android agent adds the same English strings to `strings.xml`; `crossClient.test.ts`
  pairs by identical English, so take the English wording **verbatim from the list in the
  design's section 8 and this ticket** and do not invent variants. If you need a string the
  design does not word, write it down in your commit message so the orchestrator can align the
  two clients.

## Tests

Page tests for each screen change (the existing `*.test.tsx` files show the harness), the
chooser, the gating against a protocol-3 server, and the error strings. A new test must fail
with its change reverted; say which you checked by mutation.

## Conventions

`cd web && npm test` (vitest) and `npm run lint`/`tsc` as the gate does — see
`verify-all.sh`. Do not run `npm install`; the orchestrator symlinked `node_modules`. Commit on
your branch with `(T-nnn)` and the trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5
<noreply@anthropic.com>`. Never touch gittoc, never push.
